title: Tidal-band TEP prior: gravitational tides ARE the TEP signal
interpretation: The tidal-band kernel does not beat the full-band kernel (-1.67%).  The tidal lines alone do not carry sufficient predictive power without the continuum.
pre_registered_prediction: The gravitational tidal lines (24h, 12h, 8h, 6h solar + 12.4h M2 lunar) are the strongest and most spatially coherent component of the TEP field (Paper 1: lambda=4677 km at tidal frequencies vs 1502 km post-tidal).  The tidal-band kernel should beat both the full-band kernel (which dilutes the tidal signal with continuum noise) and the notched kernel (which removes the tidal signal entirely).  If it also beats empirical covariance on independent-year data, that is direct evidence that gravitational coupling carries predictive power.
correction: Step 127 notched OUT the tidal lines, treating them as atmospheric modulation.  This was backwards — the tidal lines are gravitational in origin.  This step corrects the framing by isolating and leveraging the gravitational tidal band.
